# ZCU216 MIMO MTS overlay

## Features

* Multi-Tile Synchronization
* 16 ADC, 16 DAC fully enabled
* Clocks
  * 4Gsps sampling rate for all DACs
  * 2Gsps sampling rate for all ADCs
  * 500MHz fabric clock (8 samples per cycle)
  * Externally referenced to 500MHz PL_CLK clock by CLK104 J11
  * Generated by CLK104 LMX
  * Aligned by 5MHz PL_SYSREF clock by CLK104 LMK
* Digital mixer
  * NCO mixer (IQ) digital up/down conversion
  * NCO phase aligned
* 64k samples buffer for:
  * Arbitrary waveform generator, broadcasted to all DACs
  * I and Q waveforms for each ADC
* Trigger
  * Internally generated
  * Synchronous trigger to all DACs / ADCs

## Status

* [x] ADC / DAC waveforms
* [x] MTS
* [x] NCO phase alignment
* [x] Trigger source multiplex
